status: proposed integration schema; map carefully to existing project field names

required_fields.deadline: YYYY-MM-DD — application deadline, not sanction date
required_fields.funding_type: string — government, non-government, industry, international, etc.
required_fields.source.verified: boolean — true only after source is actually checked

recommended_additional_fields.call_status: open, closing_soon, closed, cancelled, or unknown
recommended_additional_fields.eligibility_rules: structured conditions extracted from official guidelines
recommended_additional_fields.allowable_costs: structured cost categories and source locators
recommended_additional_fields.mock_record: true only for synthetic test data; mock records must never enter production calls

data_model_rules: Keep application_date, sanction_date and application deadline as separate fields.
Keep awarded grants and open funding opportunities in separate datasets.
Do not infer active status from a past award.
A source URL alone does not establish eligibility, novelty, or compliance.
Treat missing fields as unknown; do not fabricate official values.
